instruction: I find dense information easier to manage when it is simplified and saved as a persistent reference. Read the local SELF hydration guide PDF in Microsoft Edge and create a Sticky Note containing its hydration-system recommendations for road or trail running, hiking or walking, and official races. Use the article's exact wording without paraphrasing, and keep one recommendation per line in webpage order.
gt_steps: Open the local PDF snapshot in Microsoft Edge.
Switch to the SELF hydration article in Microsoft Edge.

Enter the following article text in the note, one recommendation per line:
`For anything like road and trail running, you’ll want a system that keeps your water and gear close to your body to cut down on bouncing. In that case, most runners opt for vests and belts.`
`If you’re hiking or walking, a daypack or waist pack should do just fine.`
`For official races, always research what kind of hydration systems are allowed first. If you plan on running with a permitted hydration pack, she recommends training with it prior to race day so you can get comfortable with how it feels beforehand.`
Keep the completed note saved in Sticky Notes.

points: For anything like road and trail running, you’ll want a system that keeps your water and gear close to your body to cut down on bouncing. In that case, most runners opt for vests and belts.
If you’re hiking or walking, a daypack or waist pack should do just fine.

For official races, always research what kind of hydration systems are allowed first. If you plan on running with a permitted hydration pack, she recommends training with it prior to race day so you can get comfortable with how it feels beforehand.
